ml.model: y_i = h_i * tan(theta_ml); displacements relative to centred operational neutral
ml.height_frame: backboard local vertical from common foot/backboard pitch axis; fixed setup, independent of AP pitch
ml.effort: tau_ml = sum(h_i sec(theta_ml)^2 F_i), N m
ml.velocity_note: Conservative simulation rate: h_max * sec(limit_rad)^2 * velocity_rad_s <= 0.02 m/s.
ml.limit_note: Derived from measured +/-0.335 m independent slide travel: min atan(slide_limit/h_i).

servo.note: Provisional linear servo gains for the torso and hip lateral slides.

limits_status: Estimated geometry-based travel; provisional simulation velocity/servo settings, no encoder calibration.

direct_pitch.note: Direct generalized pitch torque; angular servo gains approximate original slider servo at reference Jacobian. Full removed-stage/rod reduced dynamics applied separately with one physics-step acceleration lag.
